<thought>We need the precursors for the product when applying template 74054. The template corresponds to the reaction: CC(=O)O + Cc1ccccc1 >> CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C. Therefore the retrosynthetic precursors are the two reactants: acetic acid (CC(=O)O) and toluene (Cc1ccccc1). Return as list of lists.</thought>
<final_answer>[['CC(=O)O', 'Cc1ccccc1']]</final_answer>
